response.answer: For external validation, aim for a sample size of at least 2430 participants, with 100 events per variable for adequate calibration assessment.

results.content: Diagnostic prediction models make predictions about the current health status of a patient, whereas prognostic prediction models estimate the probability of a health outcome in the future[1](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-021-00549-7#ref-CR1 "van Smeden, M., Reitsma, J. The six AIPM development phases range from preparation and data collection to implementation in daily healthcare practice (see Box [1](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-021-00549-7#Sec2)) and form the core structure and driver for this review. These phases are based on the predominant phases in clinical prediction model research[4](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-021-00549-7#ref-CR4 "Steyerberg, E. The search strings consisted of a combination of search terms related to: (i) guidelines, quality criteria, best practices and reporting standards (ii) artificial intelligence, including machine-learning and prediction modeling in general and (iii) topics relating to one of the six phases of AIPM development (see Box [1](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-021-00549-7#Sec2)), such as ‘data cleaning’ for phase 1 and ‘impact assessment’ for phase 5.
